title: afrodaphne elata
intro: Afrodaphne elata, commonly known as the African sandalwood, is a plant species belonging to the Lauraceae family, native to the tropical regions of West Africa. The health benefits of Afrodaphne elata include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit sedative and anxiolytic effects, promoting relaxation and reducing stress levels. The bioactive constituents of Afrodaphne elata include sesquiterpenes, such as sandalwood oil, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its distinctive fragrance.
